messages:
jessica: Quick design review — the billing dashboard mock I shared just now. Main asks: where should invoice download live (org header vs project panel), and a11y/copy nits for the token breakdown widget?

mike: Saw it. My instinct is org header for invoices so customers see consolidated billing first, but project-level quick-download is handy for teams. Maybe both?

alejandro: Both sounds fine but worried about duplicated state. If we put a download button in the org header it should default to org-wide invoice, with a project-scoped dropdown in the panel.

sarah: +1 for both. For keyboard users, the project panel button needs a clear focus order; currently in the mock it appears after the chart legend which feels odd.

ellie: Accessibility note: the red/green delta color in the token breakdown fails AA contrast on small labels. Recommend switching to a high-contrast purple/teal pair and adding an icon (up/down chevron) so color isn't the only signal.

mike: Good catch. Also, microcopy: the token breakdown header says "Token spend (est)" — can we change to "Estimated token spend"? It's clearer.

jessica: Agreed on copy. On invoices: if we expose download at two places, we must clarify scope in the CTA: "Download org invoice (All projects)" vs "Download project invoice (this project)". That should reduce confusion.

alejandro: For data freshness, show the invoice generation timestamp next to CTA, like "Generated Mar 12, 2026 · UTC" so users know why numbers might differ from charts.

design-bot: Auto-check: chart tooltip hit area is < 24px on mobile breakpoint. Recommend expanding to 44px.

sarah: UX nit: the stacked spend chart currently assumes daily granularity. Some customers want weekly/rolling views. Can we expose a small toggle (Day / Week / Month) above the chart?

ellie: VoiceOver note: the breakdown table rows aren't announcing the percentage change. Suggest adding aria-live region or accessible label: "Project X: $1,234, up 12% from last period".

mike: Implementation question — if we add both invoice CTAs, is there an API change? Backend team: can the invoice endpoint accept an optional project_id param without duplicating generation?

alejandro: Backend can accept project_id optional; we already have that filter in invoices service. No generation duplication. Need a migration check for very large orgs, but endpoint exists.

jessica: Action items: 1) Ellie to propose new color tokens + icon for delta states and update mock (due EOD). 2) Sarah to annotate keyboard/focus order and mobile hit targets. 3) Mike to update copy and CTA text. 4) Alejandro to confirm invoice endpoint accepts project_id and flag any perf concerns. 5) I'll iterate mock to add both CTAs with timestamp and a scope tooltip.

ellie: I'll also add an a11y checklist in the mock (color contrast, aria labels, screenreader text).

mike: One more microcopy ask — change chart legend "Consumed" to "Tokens consumed" so it's explicit for non-technical PMs.

jessica: Good call. And let's keep the project download tucked into the overflow menu on small screens to avoid crowded header.

alejandro: Sounds solid. I'll test the invoice endpoint with a 500-project org later today and report back.

design-bot: Reminder: run a11y-ci after the next deploy — there are 3 new failures queued for the billing page.

sarah: OK, I'll block time to validate keyboard flow after mock updates. Thanks all :rocket:
